map.📐 磨损速率怎么算: 📐 How the Wear Rate Is Derived
map.磨损率 =（新胎深度 − 当前深度）÷ 已行驶里程。用实测速率推算剩余里程，比按: Wear rate = (new tread depth − current depth) ÷ distance driven. Projecting remaining distance from the measured rate matches your own car better than estimating by age, although the rate changes with driving habits or roads.
map.同轴两侧花纹深度差超过 1 mm，通常指向胎压长期不一致、四轮定位失准（前束/外: A depth difference over 1 mm between tires on the same axle usually points to long-term pressure mismatch, poor alignment (toe/camber) or loose suspension bushings. When you find uneven wear, get alignment and balancing done, or new tires will wear oddly too.
map.💡 除花纹外，胎侧鼓包、裂纹、扎修补次数过多（＞3 次）或胎龄超过 6 年，即使: 💡 Beyond tread: sidewall bulges, cracking, too many puncture repairs (>3) or tires older than 6 years call for replacement even if tread remains.

map.四轮定位或换位后，对比前后轴磨损速度，发现异常偏磨。: After alignment or rotation, compare front and rear axle wear rates to catch abnormal uneven wear.
map.营运车辆按磨损率预测批量换胎时间，安排采购与施工窗口。: Commercial fleets predict batch tire replacement from wear rate and schedule purchase and fitting windows.
map.新胎花纹 8mm、法定下限 1.6mm（可用 6.4mm），已跑 40000km: New tread 8mm, legal limit 1.6mm (6.4mm usable), down to 4mm after 40000km (4mm consumed): wear rate = 4/40000 = 0.1mm/1000km, so the remaining 2.4mm covers about 24000km. If one side wears faster than the other, suspect alignment or suspension problems.
map.花纹到多少必须换？: At what tread depth is replacement mandatory?
map.国内乘用车胎面磨损指示块（约 1.6mm）磨平即达法定极限，必须更换；雨天建议更: For passenger cars in China, once the tread wear indicators (about 1.6mm) are flush the legal limit is reached and replacement is mandatory; in wet weather replace earlier (≥3mm) to keep drainage and grip. Sidewall cracks, bulges and aging cracks also mean immediate replacement regardless of tread.
map.四轮定位失准（前束、外倾）、悬架衬套松旷、胎压长期不当都会造成单侧重磨或羽状磨损: Misalignment (toe, camber), loose suspension bushings and chronically wrong pressure all cause one-sided or feathered wear. Once found, have alignment and balancing done, or even new tires will soon wear off-center.
map.花纹深度须在主排水沟槽多点测量取最小值，胎侧损伤不受花纹深度限制: Measure tread depth at several points in the main grooves and take the smallest value; sidewall damage is not governed by tread depth
